author: thanoob
quote: I've played every Grand Theft Auto game and they have always been one of my favorite games when they release. That being said, GTA 6 is the worst game in the series. While I can't deny that visually it is the best looking game I have ever seen, it is clunky, the story is boring, the missions all the way through chapter 1 are boring, the fact they control when you can shoot people or steal cars is not like typical GTA games. GTA has had girlfriends throughout the series, but GTA 6 takes it to the max and over does it to the point it's redundant. The 99 review score was definitely not earned, especially when the reviewers give it a perfect score and proceed to say, "this isn't a perfect game" "it has lots of problems and the story has major ups and downs, and at times a bit boring." Rockstar trolled their entire user base and people are disappointed they waited 13 years for this game and it turns out like this.. Unfortunately I'll never support a Rockstar game going forward, I'd rather go back and play San Andreas for the 8th playthrough than finish GTA 6. I wish game developers would stop trying to please their investors while neglecting the gamers who even made them a big name in the first place. Hope the 3 billion dollar cash grab was worth their reputation..
